{{Quote|Ahh, the smugglers. They have been a thorn in our side for awhile. Their ground operatives have stolen too many of our missions and goals. For some reason, their ship has been shot down by forces unknown. Looks as if they have more enemies than we thought.|[[Andria E'liyha]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Andria E'liyha|Lok}}</ref>}}
The '''Downed Blood Razor's Transport''' was a camp built around a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the [[Blood Razors]] that had crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. Since that [[Time/Legends|time]], it had been used as a base of operations for the Blood Razors.<ref name="SWG:DBRT" />

==History==
{{Quote|The downed Bloodrazor vessel is on Lok though the exact location is unknown.|[[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:AT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Adar Tallon"}}</ref>}}
[[File:BloodRazorsTransport.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Aerial view of the downed transport.]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Baldwin]] sent a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to smuggle contraband to the fence [[Briscoe]] at the downed transport.<ref name="SWG:SC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Smuggle Contraband|Lok}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the outcast [[Andria E'liyha]] convinced a spacer to attack the Blood Razor camp in order to steal the treasure of the pirates.<ref name="SWG:AE" /> Around the same time, a spacer entered the camp, fought some pirates and collected a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] left behind by [[Rydel Delan]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

The same year, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] officer [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] dispatched a Rebel operative to the downed Blood Razor vessel. The spacer retrieved the security override codes of a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] that was carrying a captured Rebel pilot.<ref name="SWG:AT" />
